```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo      = FALSE,
  message   = FALSE,
  warning   = FALSE,
  out.width = "100%"
)
library(ghreadme)
```

```{r who_am_i, results = "asis"}
who_am_i(
  name   = "{{name}}",
  likes  = "{{likes}}",
  learn  = "{{learn}}",
  work   = "{{work}}",
  collab = "{{collab}}"
)
```

## GitHub activity

```{r gh_badges, results = "asis"}
gh_badges(
  username = "{{username}}",
  badge    = c("details", "stats", "repo_lang"),
  theme    = "dark"
)
```
